notes.title: VirZOOM Gamepad Emulator Support Update
notes.content:
We're sorry to say that for the time being we cannot further support the VirZOOM Gamepad Emulator.  We will happily leave it here for anyone to download and use, and you can continue to reference the documentation we have for it at:

https://virzoom.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/help/pages/1835083/Gamepad+Emulator

We have a small team and need to focus on other priorities in this rapidly changing VR market.  If there is an opportunity to revisit the emulator in the future, we would love to do so.  We hope everyone understands why we had to make this decision.
